en.batchPartial: Deleted {ok}; {fail} could not be deleted (records kept)
en.confirmIrreversible: Deleting the local file is permanent — it does not go to the recycle bin.
en.confirmPresenceBlocked: That path is not a regular file (a directory or a symlink); only the record can be deleted.
en.confirmPresenceChanged: The file no longer matches what was downloaded (size or mtime changed); only the record can be deleted.
en.confirmPresenceMissing: The file is no longer at its original location (moved or renamed); only the record can be deleted.
en.confirmPresenceUnknown: This record has no saved output path (from an earlier version); only the record can be deleted.
en.deleteReasonBusy: The local file could not be deleted right now (it may be in use, or the disk is read-only)
en.deleteReasonChanged: The local file no longer matches what was downloaded (it may have been replaced); for safety it was not deleted
en.deleteReasonDenied: Deleting the local file was denied (insufficient permissions)
en.deleteReasonGone: The local file is no longer where it was (record deleted)
en.deleteReasonIsDir: That path is a directory and cannot be deleted as a file
en.deleteReasonIsLink: That path is a symbolic link; for safety it was not deleted
en.deleteReasonNoPath: This record has no saved output path; only the record could be deleted
en.deleteReasonRunning: The download is still running; nothing was deleted
en.emptyHint: Files you download with smart_download show up here; live progress also appears in the bottom-right corner while a download runs.
en.revealDisabled: File is no longer where it was downloaded
en.revealFailed: Could not show it in a folder (the host has no remote.session, or the path is unusable)
en.title: Downloads
